sign.schemesHint: Schemes can be combined freely. Enabling V3 or V4 also enables V2 automatically. Disabling V2 while V4 is on will be rejected by apksigner.
sign.schemeV1Desc: Baseline JAR signature; needed for Android 6.0 and below. Disabling may break installs on older devices.
sign.schemeV2Desc: Improves integrity and installation verification speed.
sign.schemeV3Desc: Provides modern integrity signing; single-certificate signing does not generate V3.1, which is used for certificate rotation.
sign.schemeV4Desc: Also creates an .idsig file for incremental installation.
sign.resignDescription: Re-signing removes the existing signature and signs with “{{label}}”. If the certificate differs, an installed version cannot be updated in place. Continue?
sign.riskNoV1: V1 is disabled. Android 6.0 and below may fail to install this APK. Continue?
sign.riskV3NoV2: V3 is enabled but V2 is disabled. Android 7.0 / 8.0 devices may fail to install this APK. Continue?
sign.riskV4Only: Only V4 is enabled; V2/V3 are disabled. The APK requires Android 11+ with .idsig streaming install support. Continue?
sign.inspectSchemesHint: V3.1 is only for signing certificate rotation. This signer uses one certificate, so enabling V3 does not generate V3.1. V4 requires a sibling `<APK filename>.idsig` file.
sign.stripConfirmDescription: This will remove all V1/V2/V3/V3.1 signing blocks and the matching .idsig (V4) from the APK, and save to the chosen directory. The original file is not modified. The filename will automatically get the `.unsigned` suffix.
sign.stripResultSize: Output size: {{size}} bytes, removed {{removed}} V1 file(s)
sign.riskV4NeedsV2OrV3: V4 signing requires V2 or V3 to be enabled (apksigner rejects this combination). Please enable V2 or V3 first.
sign.rotationSummaryHint: Rotation always enables V1 / V2 / V3 / V3.1; V4 is independently optional.
sign.rotationV4Desc: Optional — emits a sibling .idsig file when enabled
sign.rotationNoLineage: Create or import a lineage in Settings → Signatures → Lineage first.
sign.rotationMissingLineage: Selected lineage could not be found
sign.resignDescriptionRotation: APK is already signed. Rotation lineage "{{label}}" ({{old}} → {{new}}) will overwrite the existing signature. Continue?

signatures.title: Signatures

signatures.warnPlaintext: Passwords are stored in plaintext in a local config file. Keep your machine access locked down.

signatures.dnameHint: Empty fields use defaults; CN defaults to "Android" when blank.
signatures.passwordMismatch: Keystore password and Key password must be identical. Please use the same password for both and retry.

adb.cannotOpenDataDirPermission: Cannot access /data/data/{{pkg}} ({{device}}): permission denied. Make sure the app is a debug build, or the device is rooted, then retry.

adb.cannotOpenDataDirNoRoot: Cannot access /data/data/{{pkg}} ({{device}}): device root required. Retry on a rooted device, or install a debug build of the app.

adb.cannotOpenDataDirNotFound: Cannot access /data/data/{{pkg}} ({{device}}): directory not found. The app data may have been cleared, or the app hasn't run on this device yet.

lineages.title: Lineage Management
lineages.subtitle: Manage signing lineages for key rotation. The Sign view can pick a saved lineage to run V3.1 rotation signing.
lineages.empty: No lineages yet — create or import one to enable rotation signing.
lineages.newDescription: Generate a lineage file via apksigner rotate from the old keystore, capturing the old signing certificate. The new key is supplied at signing time.
lineages.importDescription: Import a .lineage file from external tooling. You still need to pick matching old/new signature configs.
lineages.deleteDescription: Delete lineage "{{label}}"? Only the JADB-managed file and metadata are removed; already-signed APKs are not affected.
lineages.sameSignatureWarning: Old and new signatures must differ
lineages.needTwoSignatures: At least two signature configs are required to create a lineage.
